messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: BridgeFlow reserved pool ready for handoff. Planned capacity: 1,200 slots, steady QPS target 320, allowed burst 650. Need final sign-offs on priming duration, autoscale knobs, and run window. Customer is watching renewal KPIs; want 48h post-cutover health check.

julia_se: Thanks. Two quick items: 1) Do we need full-prefix priming or just hot endpoints? 2) Any model-fallback toggles we should enable during surge?

leila_sre: For BridgeFlow I recommend full-prefix priming 48->72h (48 is borderline historically). We'll flip model fallback ON but keep it in monitoring-only mode until we validate. Also set request batching to 20 for this tenant to smooth latency.

tom_ops: Proposed run window: 02:30-05:30 UTC (low traffic). Ops will keep burst enabled for first 45m then disable to test autoscale. Rollback plan: instant traffic-shift to shared fallback pool + scale to safe replicas (pre-approved). Rollback owner: tom_ops.

nora_pm: Customer success asked for token-p99, cold-start counts, and error_risk tag in post-cutover report. I'll prepare the customer-facing deck and post-cutover survey; aim for 24h and 48h touchpoints. Renewal signal: if p99 > 800ms for >10% of requests at 24h, we schedule an escalation.

julia_se: Draft autoscale policy (please comment):

```yaml
min_replicas: 1
max_replicas: 20
target_qps_per_replica: 55
scale_up_threshold: 0.65
scale_down_threshold: 0.35
cooldown_seconds: 45
eviction_grace: 30s
```

leila_sre: Suggested edits: target_qps_per_replica -> 50, add stabilization_window: 90s, and set max_replicas: 18 to reduce overshoot. Also enable autoscale metrics export to ops-prom for real-time alerts.

maria_cs: Updated plan: priming 72h, run two load-test iterations during window: iteration A ramp->steady->spike, iteration B spike-first then steady to confirm hysteresis. Load test schedule: 2025-08-12T02:30:00Z and 2025-08-13T02:30:00Z. CI harness: https://ci.redwood/tests/bridgeflow-prime :link:

ops-bot: Load test reservations confirmed for 2025-08-12T02:30:00Z and 2025-08-13T02:30:00Z. Reminder: limit simultaneous tenant stress tests to 3.

julia_se: Priming command (example):

curl -X POST https://internal-priming/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $PRIME_TOKEN" -d '{"tenant":"bridgeflow","mode":"full-prefix","hours":72}'

leila_sre: Monitoring checklist for run: p50/p90/p99 token latency, cold-start count, queue depth, GPU util, replica churn, autoscale events, and model-fallback triggers. I'll be primary monitor. tom_ops will handle traffic re-routing and rollback ops.

maria_cs: Risk notes: shared fallback capacity low this week (50% used). If we see >30% fallback usage we'll pause and escalate. Also note billing alert if token-cost spikes >15% during test.

tom_ops: A few operational commands I'll run during window:

- check replicas: redwoodctl pool status bridgeflow
- tail autoscale logs: redwoodctl logs autoscale --tail --since 10m
- trigger rollback: redwoodctl traffic shift --from bridgeflow --to shared-fallback --immediate

nora_pm: I'll schedule the 24h and 48h health checks; will include renewal-risk flag in notes. Also will capture customer survey and NPS snippet.

maria_cs: Action items:
- leila_sre: apply autoscale edits (target_qps_per_replica=50, stabilization_window=90s, max_replicas=18), enable metrics export
- julia_se: start 72h priming job and paste logs in thread
- tom_ops: confirm run window (02:30-05:30 UTC), validate rollback procedure, and prepare ops commands snippet in runbook
- nora_pm: customer comms + 24h/48h health check calendar invites and survey

Please react with :white_check_mark: when you ACK.

julia_se: Ack :white_check_mark:

leila_sre: Ack :white_check_mark:

 tom_ops: Ack :white_check_mark:

nora_pm: Ack :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Runbook lint check passed. Next lint reminder in 12h. :robot_face:
